verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party pricing page or per-model per-token price list. The docs only mention relative pricing: batch is '50% lower cost' and flex 'matches the on-demand tier'. One old community comment cites a $0.27/1M figure, but another reports a switch to 'call us for quotes' for new models, which cuts against public prices for every hosted model.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales
